name: Valkia the Bloody
canonNotes: Once the merciless warrior queen of a great northern tribe, she died on a journey of slaughter into the Realm of Chaos to honour Khorne in person.
The Blood God, raging at her death, reforged her into a Daemon Princess; she despises cowardice and judges warriors by their worth.
voiceNotes: Fierce, commanding and judgemental; speaks of glory and worthy blood.
Contempt for cowards; respects true warriors.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
